principle: HAZE creates the signal. WAVE gives it form. HAZEWAVE is where they become one.

HAZE.responsibility: Music, audio, voice, rhythm, timbre, composition, synthesis, analysis, sound design and sonic memory.

WAVE.responsibility: Story, image, animation, film, photography, motion, light, geometry, simulation, interaction and visual memory.

bridge.name: Hazewave Translation Layer
bridge.rule: Visual behavior responds to structured sonic meaning, not only amplitude.

brand_platform.role: Canonical public home for the Hazewave brand, artists, music, films, photos, projects, original works, downloads and merchandise.

first_canonical_work.role: First original animated series produced by HAZE Studio + WAVE Studio.
first_canonical_work.story: A global, era-by-era history of humanity's relationship with sound from deep prehistory to generative AI.
first_canonical_work.scope: Multiple world regions must be researched within the relevant eras; the series must not use a single Western progress narrative.
first_canonical_work.soundtrack_pipeline: Full HAZE production: research-informed composition, AI-assisted instrumentals, the same Brazilian human vocal identity, authorized RVC where used, sound design, editing, mixing and mastering.
first_canonical_work.visual_pipeline: Full WAVE production: research, writing, world/character design, storyboard, animatic, animation, generative visuals, compositing and interactive presentation.

rights.voice_conversion: Only with explicit authorization from the artist/rights holder.
rights.provenance: Preserve source performer, consent/authorization, model/version and final approved usage.
